# GCAM Annual Meeting 2025
<!-------------------------->
<!-------------------------->
<p align="center"> <img src="images/divider.png"></p>

## Description

At the 2025 GCAM Annual Meeting, a series of training sessions were held over Zoom and Gathertown, most of which utilized MSD-LIVE to host hands-on Jupyter Notebook tutorials. The purpose of the training sessions was to provide introductions and tutorials at various levels for GCAM, gcamdata, and various tools and topics related to GCAM. Links to the Jupyter Notebooks on MSD-LIVE are provided below, as well as the PDF versions of the Notebooks.


<br>

# GCAM Annual Meeting 2023
<!-------------------------->
<!-------------------------->
<p align="center"> <img src="images/divider.png"></p>

## Description

At the 2023 GCAM Annual Meeting, a series of training sessions were held over Zoom. The purpose of the training sessions was to provide introductions and tutorials at various levels for GCAM, gcamdata, and various tools and topics related to GCAM. The presentations used in these training sessions are provided below.


<br>

## Course Material

<table style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%;">
  <thead style="background-color: #2A2A2A; color: white;">
    <tr>
      <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: left; width: 20%;">Topic</th>
      <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Description</th>
      <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: center;">Slides</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">GCAM 6.0 Overview</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Introductory guide to setting up and running GCAM 6.0</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;"><a href="https://github.com/JGCRI/gcam_training/blob/main/presentations/gcam_annual_meeting_2023_trainings/how_to_run_GCAM.pdf">Link</a></td>
    </tr>
      <tr>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">GCAM Data System</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Introduction to gcamdata (GCAM's data system), including R package management with renv</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;"><a href="https://github.com/JGCRI/gcam_training/blob/main/presentations/gcam_annual_meeting_2023_trainings/gcamdata.pdf">Link</a></td>
    </tr>
      <tr>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Scenario Adjustment</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Guide to designing and implementing scenarios in GCAM</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;"><a href="https://github.com/JGCRI/gcam_training/blob/main/presentations/gcam_annual_meeting_2023_trainings/scenario_adjustment.pdf">Link</a></td>
    </tr>
      <tr>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Modifying and Creating Input XMLs</td>

      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;"><a href="https://github.com/JGCRI/gcam_training/blob/main/presentations/gcam_annual_meeting_2023_trainings/create_xmls_user_mod.pdf">Link</a></td>

      <tr>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Querying GCAM Outputs</td>

      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;"><a href="https://github.com/JGCRI/gcam_training/blob/main/presentations/gcam_annual_meeting_2023_trainings/querying_GCAM_outputs.pdf">Link</a></td>
    </tr>
      <tr>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">GCAM-USA</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: left;">Introduction to GCAM-USA, GCAM's U.S. state-level submodule</td>
      <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;"><a href="https://github.com/JGCRI/gcam_training/blob/main/presentations/gcam_annual_meeting_2023_trainings/GCAM-USA.pdf">Link</a></td>
